## v1.0.0

- Organized the full course into seven weeks for BYU-Idaho, Winter 2027 Second Block, February 22–April 8.
- Listed Rob Teigen as Professor and Kyle Matheson as Teaching Assistant. Unknown course details, exact deadlines, and institutional policy text remain blank.
- Retained all readings, learning outcomes, six sprints, peer testing, both exams, rubrics, and the 450-point grading model.
- Made Codex the primary tool and Claude a supported alternative, with local starter files and shared workflows.
- Preserved the original tracked source and its release history in an archive excluded from the course site. See [Credits](99-credits.qmd).
